subject.title: `messages.visibleReplies` change requires gateway restart despite “No gateway restart needed”

question: Should the current-main visible-replies reload behavior be backported to the next patch release for users on v2026.7.1, or is the existing release restart workaround acceptable until the next normal release?
rationale: The source and test indicate a likely main-only correction, but only maintainers can choose release timing and backport policy.

options.title: Backport the targeted reload fix
options.body: Ship the current-main runtime-snapshot behavior in the next patch release and link this issue to that release.

options.title: Keep it main-only
options.body: Document that v2026.7.1 requires a gateway restart after this config change until the next scheduled release.

recommendation.title: Backport the targeted reload fix
recommendation.body: Ship the current-main runtime-snapshot behavior in the next patch release and link this issue to that release.

likelyOwner.reason: Release inclusion and backport timing are most directly connected to the tagged release history available for the reported version.
